## Spec

RoleBindingSpec grants Role at Scope to Subjects.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `spec.role` | `string` | **Required.**<br>Length: 1 to 63 |
| `spec.scope` | `object` | BindingScope narrows a role binding (§8.5).<br>Validation: cluster scope has no name; other scopes require a name (`!has(self.kind) \|\| self.kind == 'cluster' ? !has(self.name) \|\| self.name.size() == 0 : has(self.name) && self.name.size() > 0`) |
| `spec.scope.kind` | `string` | Kind is cluster, zone, zonegroup (v0.2) or clientgroup (reserved).<br>One of: `cluster`, `zone`, `zonegroup`, `clientgroup` |
| `spec.scope.name` | `string` | Length: at most 253 |
| `spec.subjects` | `[]object` | **Required.**<br>Items: 1 to 256 |
| `spec.subjects[].kind` | `string` | **Required.** Kind is User, Group or ServiceAccount.<br>One of: `User`, `Group`, `ServiceAccount` |
| `spec.subjects[].name` | `string` | **Required.**<br>Length: 1 to 253 |
| `spec.subjects[].namespace` | `string` | Length: at most 63 |

## Example

`config/samples/kudurru.io_v1alpha1_rolebinding.yaml`:

```yaml
apiVersion: kudurru.io/v1alpha1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: home-editors
  namespace: dns
spec:
  role: operator
  scope:
    kind: zone
    name: home
  subjects:
    - kind: ServiceAccount
      name: automation
      namespace: dns
```
